text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from shopping
with Satono Crown—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh, sounds interesting.
Trainer, are you confident with this kind of thing?
choice_data_list: I don't think there are that many, really.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you really don't sound confident at all!
Do you have bitter memories about it or something?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Things like this are just luck of the draw,
so don't take it so seriously!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, from our shopping earlier!
Didn't we get a raffle ticket?
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, I do have one ticket.
Come to think of it, I do have one ticket.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Perfect timing! Why don't the two of us spin it together?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't overthink your posture,
it might actually lead to better results, you know?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it a shot!
Yeah, let's give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now that's how it's done!
Excuse me~, I'd like one play please!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now, I wonder what I'll win?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Great! Fortune! Great! Prosperity!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In sync with Satono Crown,
I spun the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...!
I actually pulled it...! 
Hou-yeh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: For someone who said she had no confidence, you sure got super lucky!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
You should take these travel vouchers!
choice_data_list: It's your luck. You take it!
This is your luck. You take it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"No, you are the one... Wait, ahaha!
We're gonna be stuck in an endless loop!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...If it's come to this!
Let's decide who's worthy of the travel voucher with a debate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let me start with my argument.
The reason why you deserve the hot springs trip voucher.
That reason is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because if you hadn't been there,
I never would have entered the raffle!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If it was just me, I would've finished shopping and gone home.
But! Today, you were right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, a lottery raffle wouldn't appeal to me that much.
But I just thought it sounded fun to spin it with you."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: In other words! You're the one who gave me the chance to spin the raffle, so you should have it!
choice_data_list: I pulled back because you were there too!
I backed off because you were there too!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
There are two in there.
Share nicely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh, really!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's true... Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, about that travel voucher from earlier...
How about we use it together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
It'll be much more fun than going alone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright, so going there is decided!
Now for the dates... but doing it right away is impossible, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Once I get results and things settle down, I guess.
Once I get results and things settle down, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
First, let's focus on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Once we've run our hearts out through the end of the year, we can enjoy ourselves to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So, I'm counting on you going forward as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to their eventual hot springs trip,
the two set off running together toward their goal once more!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
First prize...! Wonderful!
We did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Look at this thick-cut carrot and hamburger steak!
To think the shopping street had such a masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's the pride of this place,
but sadly it isn't very well-known.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying my best to promote it, you know?
I'm just really not good at that kind of thing...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see... If that's the case,
would you allow me to lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That's everything I could've hoped for!
...But are you really sure about this, young lady?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: A video would probably be best here as the standard approach. First, let's call in the ideal cast—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, at Satono Crown's suggestion,
we began filming a promotional video.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Like I mentioned on LANE, please eat freely without worrying about the cameras."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~... I-I don't have much confidence, but
I'll do my very best, hauu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm counting on you to take the photos!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa~. S-So much meat juice...!
The sauce is glistening too... It's dazzling.
Is it really okay for someone like me to eat this...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Please eat up while it's still hot.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
!? The meat and carrots are so tender...!
Th-They're bursting with flavor in my mouth!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I-I can't stoppp!
It's too deliciooous~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"You can eat this Special-Grade Carrot Hamburg Steak
at the shopping district! Hurry on over, everyone~♪"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I just ate normally,
was everything okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect!
It was just as I imagined!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Doto-san,
you're a genius at finding good points!
Thanks to you, I was able to convey what's so great about Salisbury steaks.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-That's impossible!
Not in a million years~~...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... I'm glad I could be of help.
Ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's all up to you! If you spread the word on social media,
everyone's gonna get hungry and head down to the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's already being Re-Umated!
Just as planned!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to the cooperation of both of you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's all share
the rest of the Hamburg steaks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown achieved splendid results
and looked thoroughly pleased!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wah, so many...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it looks delicious, but it might be tough for just the two of us to eat this much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, that's it! If we go there...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We arrived at the kitchen of a restaurant. Apparently, it's a high-end establishment frequented by Satono Crown and Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
How about this carrot?
I believe both its color and luster are top-notch.

text_block_list.name: Chef
text_block_list.text:
Well now, you certainly have a keen eye.
I shall gladly make use of them.

text_block_list.name: Chef
text_block_list.text: Do you have any preferences for the menu? Please, feel free to order whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Please serve it hors d'oeuvre style.
So everyone can enjoy eating together!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Departing from the carrot's 'default.'
A universe expanding inside the mouth... It's pure 'COMF.'

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So this is the taste of space, huh...
...I want more.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone seems to be enjoying their meal.
I must make sure to thank the chef again.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation.
I am thoroughly enjoying the party.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I especially loved the salad.
The apple and lemon really gave it a kick... It brings back memories.
A familiar taste of home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you like it.
Please, eat as much as you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Satono Crown,
we were able to thoroughly enjoy a lively carrot meal!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
My, it's so big!
It looks like it'll be wonderfully fluffy and delicious once roasted.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's almost dinner time...
Trainer, let's split it in half—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Cheval!
What's up, doing some shopping?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah……
Just, you know……

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... carrots.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something wrong with this carrot?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's nothing...
It just happened to catch my eye, is all..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm?
Come to think of it, isn't it already dinner time...?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Piping hot roasted carrots.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: !! Ah, this is, um...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer.
It's fine for Cheval too, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we were just discussing what to do
with these carrots.
Wondering if it's a bit too much before dinner."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If we divide it into three equal parts, it'll be just the right amount,
so I need you to help out!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
R-Really, it's fine...!
Save it so the two of you can share it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I want to taste it right now.
Think of it as doing me a favor, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...In that case... maybe I will eat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks!
Let's all three of us enjoy eating it!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A consolation prize... Guess I'm out of luck.
Still, at least it wasn't an important lottery.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Here, you can have this tissue pack if you'd like.
I always carry some around with me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wah?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ow... Looks like I got something in my eye.
Ugh, I don't think I can open it right now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Thanks a bunch! I feel so refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still... to consume the prize
immediately after receiving it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Talk about adding insult to injury...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown sighed as she said that,
letting her shoulders drop.
